title: Mapping the Emerging Social Science of Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Gender, Race, Ethnicity, Religion, Age, Occupation)
bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing and reviewing literature on bias audits that evaluate LLMs using repeated sampling, counterfactual tests, demographic prompts, and intersectional analysis to identify systematic differences associated with specific groups and names.

Synthesizing literature on political audits and comparative studies that evaluate stable ideological tendencies and orientations in model responses across different LLM systems (e.g., ChatGPT-4, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).
Reviewing evaluations of model responses to assess cultural orientations and variations in moral judgments across different prompting strategies, model sizes, and the framing of specific dilemmas.
